global.title: NATO chief vows more support for Ukraine after Russian drone strikes near Poland
global.summary: After Russian drone strikes near the Ukraine-Poland border, NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte pledged increased alliance support for Ukraine, while Poland moved to tighten border security.
global.whyItMatters: This signals a widening risk in Europe and gives pastors a timely lens for praying about war, fear, and the protection of civilians.

global.title: Ebola cases in DR Congo top 7,000 as outbreak spreads in conflict-hit regions
global.summary: Government data in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows confirmed Ebola cases have passed 7,000, with more than 3,300 deaths as the virus reaches remote areas already strained by armed conflict.
global.whyItMatters: A growing health crisis in fragile regions invites prayer, compassion, and awareness of how suffering compounds where systems are already weak.

global.title: Saudi pipeline shutdown and Hormuz tensions push oil prices higher
global.summary: Oil prices rose again as supply fears deepened after attacks linked to the wider Iran conflict and Saudi Arabia shut down a major pipeline used to bypass the Strait of Hormuz.
global.whyItMatters: Energy shocks often become cost-of-living shocks, affecting families in the congregation and shaping the pastoral mood around anxiety and provision.

canadian.title: Carney pitches Canada as a stable, rules-based alternative for global investors
canadian.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney is making a fresh appeal to major investors, presenting Canada as trustworthy and stable as the trade conflict with the U.S. deepens.
canadian.whyItMatters: This offers a new angle beyond tariff headlines and may shape economic confidence, jobs, and the tone of public life across Canada.

canadian.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs take effect on $27.6 billion in U.S. goods
canadian.summary: Canada's new tariffs, ranging from 15% to 50%, are now in force on a broad set of U.S. products after trade talks collapsed, with Ottawa also pointing to support for affected businesses and workers.
canadian.whyItMatters: Pastors should watch for downstream pressure on local employers, household budgets, and the emotional strain that economic uncertainty brings.

canadian.title: Trump threatens to cut Canadian products from U.S. government procurement
canadian.summary: The White House is escalating the trade dispute again by warning that Canadian products could be removed from U.S. government purchasing programs.
canadian.whyItMatters: This suggests the conflict may broaden beyond tariffs, with possible consequences for Canadian industries, workers, and long-term planning.

local.title: Abbotsford moves ahead on Lefeuvre Road recreation park plans
local.summary: Abbotsford council has approved site and design work for a new recreation park on Lefeuvre Road after the Agricultural Land Commission rejected the previous King Road proposal.
local.whyItMatters: Growing recreation space is a community-building story that affects families, youth, and opportunities for connection in a fast-growing city.

local.title: Fraser Valley communities prepare for BC Culture Days
local.summary: Chilliwack, Abbotsford, and Mission will host more than 50 free and pay-what-you-may arts events as BC Culture Days begins this week.
local.whyItMatters: This is a practical opportunity for churches to engage their communities, celebrate local creativity, and notice where people are already gathering.

local.title: Chilliwack senior found dead after going missing from recreation centre
local.summary: Police say a missing Chilliwack senior was found dead in the Cultus Lake area, and the death is not considered suspicious.
local.whyItMatters: This is a sobering local reminder of vulnerability, grief, and the importance of pastoral care for families facing sudden loss.

persecutedChurch.title: Boko Haram kills 11 in Adamawa State
persecutedChurch.summary: International Christian Concern reports that Boko Haram killed 11 people in Adamawa State, underscoring the continuing violence facing communities in northern Nigeria.
persecutedChurch.whyItMatters: This gives a concrete, current point for prayer and helps keep the suffering church visible before a congregation that may otherwise miss it.

persecutedChurch.title: Scottish youth rally spotlights persecuted Christians with message from the Pope
persecutedChurch.summary: More than 700 Catholic students in Scotland gathered through Aid to the Church in Need to learn about persecuted Christians worldwide, encouraged by a message of support from Pope Leo.
persecutedChurch.whyItMatters: Alongside hard news, this is a hopeful model of forming young believers to pray, care, and act for the global church.

leadership.title: Build for longevity, not applause in ministry leadership
leadership.summary: A framework on urban church planting argues for sustainable leadership: align vision with capacity, prioritize formation as well as function, and resist ministry models built on constant heroics.
leadership.whyItMatters: This is a timely pastoral leadership reminder that endurance, clarity, and shared support matter more than pace or platform.

goodNews.title: 9/11 remembrance tree-planting campaign begins in New York
goodNews.summary: A new initiative called Together We Grow launched with the planting of a willow oak in Battery Park, aiming to plant 3,000 trees in honor of 9/11 victims.
goodNews.whyItMatters: It is a redemptive picture of remembrance joined to renewal, a hopeful image pastors can draw on when speaking about grief and legacy.
